market_read.description: Two or three sentences on what the quotes reveal: the spread, where the outliers are, what the fee patterns show.

spread_multiple.description: high / low. The headline number for the report.

shortlist.description: Dealer ids worth a negotiation call, best prospect first. Exclude anyone with a disqualifying red flag.

excluded.description: Dealers deliberately not called back, with the reason.

target_otd_usd.description: What to aim for on this call. Roughly 10-12% below their quoted OTD, adjusted for days on lot and contested fees. INTERNAL ONLY — never spoken.

opening_offer_usd.description: The number the agent actually states first.

primary_lever.description: The strongest evidenced lever against THIS dealer.

contested_fees.description: Specific line items to challenge, named as the dealer named them.

rationale.description: Why this target and this lever, citing the evidence.
